payload.title: Drafted judgment questions: make polarity obvious and reviewable
payload.description: humanus draft-questions (draftEditorialQuestions) inverted 2 of 30 drafted detectors for a real publication policy: it asked 'does the document have a clear US connection?' and flagged 'yes', which would mark every relevant item. The approval screen for PPY-604f84 must show each question with 'flags when the answer is yes/no' and a sample pass/fail sentence, and offer a one-click flip. Report the inversion pattern to Humanus so draft-questions can self-check polarity against the policy's prohibitions.
